title: fix(plugins,react,i18n): data-bound blocks title their unresolvable-view panel in the page's language (objectui#12920)
body:
Fixes #12920
Clause-②: yes

New language-pack keys, in all ten packs: `element.KIND.sourceUnresolved` for `calendar`, `chart`, `pivotTable`, `detailView`, `relatedList`, `form`, `lineItems`, `gantt`, `grid`, `board`, `listView`, `map`, `timeline` and `component`, plus `element.component.noDataSource` and `element.relatedList.parentUnreadable`. No prop, input or export changes.

## What changed

Every data-bound block now titles its "data source could not be resolved" panel in the page's language. The panel shows when `dataSource.view` names a view the object does not have. `record:related_list` also has a panel for a failed `parentDataSource` read, and that title is translated too. Each shell reads its key through `useObjectTranslation`, and the inline `defaultValue` is the `en` pack's value, so a page without an `I18nProvider` draws the English it drew before. `check:i18n-keys` keeps the two byte-identical.

| Block | Key |
|---|---|
| `object-calendar` | `element.calendar.sourceUnresolved` |
| `object-chart` | `element.chart.sourceUnresolved` |
| `object-metric` | `element.number.sourceUnresolved` (reused: same sentence as `element:number`) |
| `object-pivot` | `element.pivotTable.sourceUnresolved` |
| `detail-view` | `element.detailView.sourceUnresolved` |
| `record:related_list` | `element.relatedList.sourceUnresolved` |
| `record:related_list`, parent read failed | `element.relatedList.parentUnreadable` |
| `object-form`, `embeddable-form`, `object-master-detail-form` | `element.form.sourceUnresolved` |
| `record:line_items` | `element.lineItems.sourceUnresolved` |
| `object-gantt` | `element.gantt.sourceUnresolved` |
| `object-grid` | `element.grid.sourceUnresolved` |
| `object-kanban` | `element.board.sourceUnresolved` |
| `list-view` | `element.listView.sourceUnresolved` |
| `object-map` | `element.map.sourceUnresolved` |
| `object-timeline` | `element.timeline.sourceUnresolved` |

- **`@object-ui/react` panel defaults.** `ElementDataSourceErrorPanel` with no `title` reads `element.component.sourceUnresolved`. `NoDataSourcePanel` with no `title` reads `element.component.noDataSource`. Only an absent `title` takes the default, as the parameter default did: a passed title wins, an empty string included. Props and markup are unchanged, and no panel component is added. The file already imported `useObjectTranslation`, so there is no new import and no cycle.
- **`plugin-map`** reads `useObjectTranslation` through `@object-ui/react`'s existing re-export, the way `useGanttTranslation` does. No `package.json` or lockfile change.
- No interpolated noun: each block kind has its own sentence, because the possessive and the noun's grammar differ by language.

## Pins

- One zh-CN pin per block kind, appended to each family's `*.elementDataSource.test.tsx`. Each renders through the real `SchemaRenderer` under a mounted zh-CN `I18nProvider` and reads the panel's heading.
- `detail-view` had no data-source pin to sit beside, so it gets `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.sourceUnresolvedTitle-12920.test.tsx` (zh-CN plus an en control).
- The parent-read title is pinned in `plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.parentDataSource-12294.test.tsx`, beside the existing parent-read error pins, which already drive a failing parent read. It checks the zh-CN heading, and that the thrown message is still shown beneath it.
- `react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/ElementDataSourcePanels.titleDefault-12920.test.tsx`: both defaults under zh-CN, an authored title and an empty title still winning, and provider-less en controls.
- Edited deliberately: `plugin-list`'s `ListView.sharedGate.test.tsx` now asserts the `en` pack value (`en.element.listView.sourceUnresolved`) instead of the English literal.

**Ablations** ran on committed HEAD through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each printed "ok mutation landed" and "ok restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty", and all four went red:
- `plugin-map`'s English literal put back (`f93cba5`): 1 failed (Expected 无法解析此地图的数据源);
- the React panel's English default put back (`f93cba5`): 1 failed (Expected 无法解析此组件的数据源);
- `title === undefined` weakened to `!title` (`f93cba5`): the empty-title pin failed;
- the related list's parent-read English literal put back (`36bfc88`): 1 failed (Expected 无法读取此相关列表的父记录).

## Verification (head 36bfc88)

- Closure build of react, i18n and the 11 plugins (`--filter 'PKG^...'`): exit 0. `type-check` of all 13: exit 0.
- Full suites of `packages/i18n`, `packages/react` and the 11 plugins, sharded where large: all passed (calendar 62 files, charts 92, dashboard 183, detail 289, form 190, gantt 100, grid 225, kanban 77, list 150, map 39, timeline 46, i18n+react 198). `plugin-detail` and `packages/i18n` were re-run at `36bfc88`.
- Controls from PR #12919 (`element-i18n-defaults-12910`, `element-english-defaults-census-12910`) and every `components` file naming the panel: 8 files, 94 tests passed.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `test-path-roots`, `new-line-citations`, `phantom-deps`, `control-bytes`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `unreferenced-sources`, `check-changeset-presence`: all exit 0. eslint on the changed files: 0 errors, and the same warning count as `main` per file.
- Done state: `git grep -n -E 'errorTitle="[^"]+"' -- 'packages/*/src/*'` prints nothing outside tests. The two `ElementDataSourceGate.tsx` defaults read the bundle.

## Acceptance notes

- `plugin-map`'s popup buttons "Edit" and "Delete" are English. They are outside the claim's surface, and no producer passes `onEdit` / `onDelete` to `ObjectMap` today.
- The eager `en` pack source grows by about 1.9 KB raw. The CI Bundle Analysis reading is pending.
